rows.text: 聞き取れなければ “Say again” と言います。
rows.source: FAA Pilot/Controller Glossary（FAA の HTML 版 glossary-a・m・g・r・s・t・u・w、2026-10-27 に読んだ）：AFFIRMATIVE「Yes.」・MISSED APPROACH「A maneuver conducted by a pilot when an instrument approach cannot be completed to a landing.」・GO AROUND「Instructions for a pilot to abandon his/her approach to landing.」・SAY AGAIN「Used to request a repeat of the last transmission.」・SPEAK SLOWER「Used in verbal communications as a request to reduce speech rate.」・STAND BY・TAXI「The movement of an airplane under its own power on the surface of an airport」・UNABLE「Indicates inability to comply with a specific instruction, request, or clearance.」／UK CAA CAP 413 Radiotelephony Manual 第 24 版（2026-07-01 発効、2026-10-27 に PDF を読んだ）：2.18 表 8（AFFIRM「Yes」・SAY AGAIN・SPEAK SLOWER「Reduce your rate of speech」・STANDBY・UNABLE「I cannot comply with your request, instruction, or clearance (Unable is normally followed by a reason)」）、2.14（decimal）、3.1（標準の言い方、言えないときだけ plain language）、3.2（ILS・QNH・RVR などは文字のまま読んでよい）、3.6「The excessive use of courtesies should be avoided.」、つづり take-off（124 か所）・aeroplanes（Chapter 4）・PAN PAN

rows.text: 権力格差（power distance）は、上司と部下の力の差を、部下の側がどれだけ大きく感じるかの尺度です。
rows.source: SKYbrary: Socio-Culture (OGHFA BN)（2026-10-27 に読んだ）：「Hofstede (1991) defines power distance as "a measure of the interpersonal power or influence between boss and subordinate as perceived by the less powerful of the two, the subordinate."」「In countries with lower power distance, such as the United Kingdom, Australia and Denmark, subordinates feel more comfortable about approaching superiors and, if necessary, contradicting them (Helmreich and Merritt, 1998).」

rows.text: SKYbrary は、Hofstede のこの定義を挙げています。
rows.source: SKYbrary: Socio-Culture (OGHFA BN)（2026-10-27 に読んだ）：「Hofstede (1991) defines power distance as "a measure of the interpersonal power or influence between boss and subordinate as perceived by the less powerful of the two, the subordinate."」「In countries with lower power distance, such as the United Kingdom, Australia and Denmark, subordinates feel more comfortable about approaching superiors and, if necessary, contradicting them (Helmreich and Merritt, 1998).」

rows.text: そして、英国などの権力格差の小さい国の例として、部下が上司に話しかけ、必要なら反対することを気楽に感じる、と書いています。
rows.source: SKYbrary: Socio-Culture (OGHFA BN)（2026-10-27 に読んだ）：「Hofstede (1991) defines power distance as "a measure of the interpersonal power or influence between boss and subordinate as perceived by the less powerful of the two, the subordinate."」「In countries with lower power distance, such as the United Kingdom, Australia and Denmark, subordinates feel more comfortable about approaching superiors and, if necessary, contradicting them (Helmreich and Merritt, 1998).」

rows.source: 14 CFR 61.83(c)・61.103(c)「Be able to read, speak, write, and understand the English language.」（eCFR の API、2026-10-23 時点の版を 2026-10-27 に読んだ）

rows.text: 英語を読み・話し・書き・理解できることです（61.83(c)・61.103(c)）。

rows.text: 米国の FAA の AC 60-28B は、この基準を ICAO の運用レベル 4（Operational Level 4）以上としています。
